scope: Only GSE137337 chronological E8.5 single-gene Dnmt1, Dnmt3b, Ehmt2 (source label G9a), Kmt2b; no double knockouts or other stages; source WT inherited from v1
license_basis: NCBI GEO imposes no restrictions on data use/distribution; author-deposited measurements and metadata show no contrary data-specific restriction. No claim of CC licensing is made. Article academic-manuscript terms and GPL3 code license are not used to license the numerical dataset. Retain attribution, accession IDs and source processing disclosure.

Dnmt1.evidence: Selected E8.5 zygotic single-gene KO in Grosswendt study has global DNA methylation loss with IAP/transposon derepression and developmental delay. Published barcode metadata contains 605 heart-tube and1122 SHF cells across12 embryos. It is not target-gene deletion, GATA4 activity suppression, or a demonstrated phenocopy of the conditional cardiac target. Broad developmental delay alone does not establish equivalent condition.

Dnmt3b.evidence: Selected E8.5 zygotic single-gene KO, methylation/imprinting regulation; 518 heart-tube and1055 SHF cells across8 embryos. Dnmt3b can cause later cardiac septation defects, which were explicitly considered; later E13.5/E16.5 septation phenotype is not evidence of comparable E8.75 conditional Gata4/Gata6 or Ctnnb1 response. Current-stage source has differentiated cardiac states and a different primary perturbation.

Ehmt2.evidence: Selected E8.5 zygotic G9a/Ehmt2 single KO affects H3K9 methylation, gene silencing and developmental progression;531 heart-tube/1014 SHF cells across11 embryos. Independent primary genetics describes broad developmental retardation without organ-specific abnormalities at E9.5, not a cardiac Gata4/beta-catenin phenocopy. Shared muscle/differentiation pathways do not prove equivalence.

Kmt2b.evidence: Selected E8.5 Kmt2b H3K4 methyltransferase KO affects CpG-island protection and differentiation progression, with347 heart-tube and876 SHF cells across10 embryos. Primary source distinguishes its epigenetic and multi-lineage behavior, without identifying it as a conditional cardiac Gata4/Gata6 or beta-catenin phenocopy. Do not confuse Kmt2b with Kmt2d or reuse ambiguous historical MLL nomenclature blindly.

statement: Scoped evidence-based phenotype review; not proof of universal absence of shared downstream responses. No organizer endorsement claimed. No same-target measurements retrieved to estimate target effect.
limitations: Zygotic whole-embryo perturbation differs from mesoderm-lineage conditional deletion
Libraries a/b are technical cell partitions, not independent biological replicates; require SNP embryo assignments for proper embryo validation
WT kernel stage states do not establish causal perturbation signs
Every source intervention is an epigenetic regulator; seven KOs still do not identify a Gata4 response
Sex, stage-shift and sequencing chemistry confounding must remain visible; embryo IDs recovered in original publisher tables
training_permission: Only completed SHA256-bound expanded files and genotype-filtered annotations in TASK_DATA_PERMIT_v2.json
